# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Identify the specific location and address of the building.
3. Record the date and time of the inspection.
4. List the names of the individuals conducting the inspection and their credentials.
5. Provide a detailed description of the part of the building inspected (e.g., basement, floor number, specific area).

6. Document all fire-safety features inspected, including:
   - Fire alarms
   - Smoke detectors
   - Fire extinguishers
   - Fire sprinkler systems
   - Emergency exits and signage
   - Fire doors and their closures
   - Electrical systems and heat sources
   - Storage of flammable materials
   - Accessibility and clearance of fire equipment

7. Write down all observed issues and deficiencies:
